title: Cursor: unify vscode-neovim entrypoint (cursor/nvim-init.lua vs lua/config/cursor.lua)
description: Two Cursor init paths exist: cursor/settings.json sets vscode-neovim.neovimInitVimPaths.darwin to cursor/nvim-init.lua (loads keymaps, dial, format.save_toggle), while init.lua checks vim.g.vscode and loads lua/config/cursor.lua (loads keymaps and format.save_toggle, missing dial). Also cursor/nvim-cursor.sh unsets NVIM_APPNAME so plugin/*.lua never autoloads when launched via nvim-cursor.sh, making the two paths drift.
design:
Pick one canonical Cursor entrypoint:
- Either have cursor/nvim-init.lua delegate to require('config.cursor') (or inline lua/config/cursor.lua into cursor/nvim-init.lua and have init.lua dofile/require the same module when vim.g.vscode is set), ensuring dial.nvim, keymaps, and format.save_toggle load identically in both paths.
- Document in AGENTS.md / comments whether plugin/*.lua vim.g.vscode guards are kept as defense-in-depth when init.lua is used without nvim-cursor.sh.
acceptance_criteria: Only one Cursor profile definition exists; dial, keymaps, and format.save_toggle load identically whether started via cursor/nvim-init.lua or init.lua with vim.g.vscode.

title: Facets: unify directory layout and deduplicate Trouble source/runner boilerplate
description: lua/facets/ splits facet definitions (lua/facets/typescript/{eslint,tsc,knip}.lua) from their runners and Trouble sources (lua/facets/{eslint,tsc,knip}/{run,trouble_source}.lua), and repeats the same ~50-line Trouble source definition and ~20-line run_* wrapper three times.
design:
1. Extract a shared factory (e.g. make_trouble_source({ mode, source, desc, preview_title })) in lua/facets/trouble.lua (or lua/facets/trouble_source.lua) so eslint, tsc, and knip do not need three separate 50-line trouble_source.lua files.
2. Replace run_eslint / run_tsc / run_knip in lua/facets/trouble.lua with a single table-driven runner helper (capture_origin -> run_fn -> set_items -> trouble.open with count/clean title -> notify on 0).
3. Co-locate or flatten lua/facets/ so each facet's detect + runner live together (or under lua/facets/typescript/<tool>.lua) instead of splitting typescript/<tool>.lua vs <tool>/run.lua.
4. Reuse a single read_package_json / workspace.read_json helper across typescript/eslint.lua, typescript/knip.lua, and playwright/e2e.lua.
acceptance_criteria: Single Trouble source factory and runner helper; no duplicated trouble_source.lua files; plugin/bqf-trouble-todo.lua and <leader>xe / <leader>xE / <leader>xT work unchanged; check-plugins passes.

title: Fix nx show projects failing in Neovim
description:
Symptom: Nx picker shows '237 projects loaded — nx show projects failed (saved glob fallback)'. UI resilience is largely done (async refresh, glob fallback, path_index/hydrate to avoid select hang). Remaining work: make nx CLI succeed in Neovim subprocesses, not just survive failure.

Diagnosis (cwd ruled out — glob finds 237 projects under correct root):
1. Node not on PATH in GUI/Cursor Neovim (most likely) — nx wrapper exists but #!/usr/bin/env node fails
2. Nx daemon bad state — retry with NX_DAEMON=false for read-only queries
3. Nx plugin/graph errors — need stderr surfaced
4. npx fallback worse in bare GUI env

Do NOT: sync nx on picker open, more glob, cache glob as nx-success.

Verify from failing workspace:
:lua print(vim.inspect(vim.system({'node','-v'},{text=true}):wait()))
:lua local r=require'nx.workspace'; local w=r.root(); print(vim.inspect(vim.system(r.nx_cmd(w,{'show','projects','--json'}),{cwd=w,text=true,env=vim.fn.environ()}):wait()))

title: Clean up dead/unfinished after/ftdetect files and nvim-cmp remnant in sql-dadbod
description:
Several filetype and plugin hooks are dead or half-finished leftovers:
1. after/ftdetect/go.lua only sets vim.o.termguicolors = true (already set globally in lua/config/options.lua:44, and not a filetype rule).
2. after/ftdetect/openapi.lua filters schemastore.catalog into a local variable and returns without calling vim.filetype.add.
3. after/ftdetect/cloudformation.lua depends on schemastore.nvim (not installed) and stops yamlls (not configured in lua/config/lsp.lua).
4. plugin/sql-dadbod.lua calls pcall(require, 'cmp') to register vim-dadbod-completion, left over from before switching to native vim.lsp.completion.
design:
1. Delete after/ftdetect/go.lua.
2. Delete after/ftdetect/openapi.lua (and decide whether to delete after/ftdetect/cloudformation.lua or replace with a static vim.filetype.add pattern without schemastore).
3. Remove the dead pcall(require, 'cmp') block from plugin/sql-dadbod.lua, keeping omnifunc = 'vim_dadbod_completion#omni'.
acceptance_criteria: after/ftdetect/go.lua and dead schemastore/cmp stubs removed; headless startup and check-plugins pass.

title: Nx: disk cache source field (nx vs glob)

acceptance_criteria: Cache JSON includes source; glob-sourced cache triggers nx retry on refresh

title: Nx: timeout on refresh_list vim.system

acceptance_criteria: refresh_list passes timeout to vim.system; hung nx aborts and falls back
